## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (53%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
InSitu (53%) and Benign (43%) are unseparated with 3% invasive risk [F1] on a flagged frozen section, deferring margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 53%, Benign 43%, Invasive 3%, Normal 0% | Split between InSitu and Benign |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% target coverage, n=132) | Cannot separate Benign from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.31 reliability (flagged); 94% OOD [F6] | Suspect out-of-distribution input quality |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | false | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 1/5 (20%) InSitu; 3/5 Benign, 1/5 Invasive [F5] | Neighbors favor Benign over InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 2, 4, 5) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (+1.30), lowers invasive score (-0.59) [F2]; 12/20 AI check · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 0, 1, 3) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (+1.34), lowers invasive score (-0.40) [F3]; 18/20 AI check · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Typical (+0.24), raises invasive score (+0.36) [F4]; 0/20 AI check · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 2) · context · Descriptive (+0.20), differs from invasive neighbor BACH_0138; 8/20 AI check · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing 3 top-risk regions drops invasive probability (+0.0114 vs random, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); uses unreliable normal lobules and mitoses (0/20 AI-checked).

## Could be wrong if
- Frozen-section quality (94% OOD) masks benign lesions (3/5 neighbors) or invasion (closest neighbor BACH_0138, 88% similarity).
- Drafted deeper levels or recut H&E reveal invasion or atypia missed on this low-reliability section (stains blocked).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 6, 10**: Inspect highest-risk tiles (risk 0.535, 0.249, 0.130) to exclude invasion versus unreliable lobule scores.
2. **Regions 2, 4, 5, 0, 1, 3**: Compare duct-confined atypia against benign tubules; consider drafted deeper levels and recut H&E.
3. **Regions 8, 9, 10, 11, 4, 7**: Check inferior, medial, lateral, and superior margins (83%–100%); defer frozen margin call.
